The employment outlook will be Limited for supervisors, other products manufacturing and assembly (NOC 92024) in Quebec for the 2025-2027 period.

The following factors contributed to this outlook:

  • Employment decline will lead to the loss of some positions.

  • There are several unemployed workers with recent experience in this occupation.

Here are some key facts about supervisors, other products manufacturing and assembly in Quebec:

  • Approximately 1,700 people work in this occupation.
  • Supervisors, other products manufacturing and assembly mainly work in the following sectors:
    • Miscellaneous manufacturing (NAICS 339): 23%

    • Plastics and rubber products manufacturing (NAICS 326): 9%

    • Machinery manufacturing (NAICS 333): 5%

    • Women: 19% compared to 48% for all occupations
